$kaynak.not: referans oyun drop tablolari istemci paketinde YOK. Gercek vSRO zincirinden uretildi: seviye -> sinif secim tablosu -> grup -> agirlikli esya secimi. itemId artik REFERANS OYUN kimligidir (itemstats.json ile dogrulanmis).

$oranNasilUygulandi.itemDropRate: rare OLMAYAN tum sanslarla carpildi (Equip/Recover/Cure/Scroll/Ammo/Reinforce/Alchemy + mob ozel ganimeti).

$optLevelSel.$not: _RefDropOptLvlSel — dusen ekipmanin +N seviyesi. Prob KUMULATIFTIR. referans oyun ground_item paketinde plus alani olmadigi icin HENUZ UYGULANMIYOR.

geriDusme.$not: RENK-KORUYUCU eslenmemis sinif geri-dusmesi (sartname madde 9): katalog maxDegree=8, D9 gruplari (25/26/27) eslesemez. Equip 25/26->24; RareEquip renk koruyarak 25->22 (bronz), 26->23 (gumus), 27->24 (altin). ProbGroup mobun KENDI MonLevel satirindan, agirliklar hedef sinifin _RefDropItemAssign.Prob_Relative satirlarindan. Isaretli girdiler items[] icinde $fallback alani tasir (ganimet() yalniz itemId/qty/chance okur).

simya.$not: Bu kosumda Alchemy/Reinforce zinciri ACILDI (onceden 0 girdi). Tas kimligi veri baglantili: DB _RefObjItem.Desc1_128 (MATTR_*) -> items.json blueOptions.opts (MATTR -> effect) -> magicstone_<effect>_<derece>; derece = kod soneki = AssignedGroup. referans oyun karsiligi OLMAYANLAR dusmez (uydurma yok): derece 9-11 (jw maxDegree=8), MATTR_SOLID / MATTR_EVADE_BLOCK / MATTR_EVADE_CRITICAL (jw tas ailesi yok). ASTRAL/APE taslari jw katalogunda VAR ama vSRO assign satirlari Service=0/Prob_Relative=0 -> ganimet zincirinde hic yoklar (veriye sadik). Elixir: _RefDropClassSel_Reinforce yalniz grup 2 (B tarifleri) dolu; jw tek kademeye daraltildi, girdiler $esleme ile isaretli. Powder (REINFORCE_PROB_UP): vSRO kaynaginda HIC drop kaydi yok (24 kodun tamaminda assign=0, monsterDrop=0, itemGroup=0 — SELECT olcumu) -> pisirilecek veri yok. ATTRStone/Tablet: jw karsiligi yok -> 0 girdi.

monsterVariants.$schema: z.object({ $comment: z.string().optional(), champion: Variant, giant: Variant })  where Variant = z.object({ chance: z.number().min(0).max(1), hpMult: z.number().min(1), dmgMult: z.number().min(1), xpMult: z.number().min(1), spExpMult: z.number().min(1), lootRolls: z.number().int().min(1), scaleMult: z.number().positive(), namePrefix: z.string() })
monsterVariants.$comment: SRO-style rarity rolls, applied per spawn (giant checked first, then champion; a monster def opts in via its `variants` flags). Multipliers scale the General stats; scaleMult is the client-side model scale; lootRolls = full passes over the drop table. PROVENANCE (audited 2026-07-29, see .reports/monster-variant-provenance.md) — retail ships NO champion/giant data: a DB-wide column scan of the live vSRO shard finds exactly two variant columns in the entire schema (Tab_RefNest.nChampionGenPercentage, Tab_RefTactics.dwChampionTacticsID), and zero _CHAMPION/_GIANT/_PARTY/_ELITE codenames among 8074 MOB_ rows. Every multiplier below is engine-coded in SR_GameServer.exe and uncertified by the decompile pass, so each field is labelled: [CONFIRMED] champion.chance 0.10 = Tab_RefNest.nChampionGenPercentage, the retail modal value on 11459/16563 nests (nest-format zones already override this per-nest via slot.nest.championPct; this global is the LEGACY-zone fallback only). [ASSUMED] giant.chance 0.03 — the real knob is the GameServer setting `GiantMonster_SpawnRatio` (string present in SR_GameServer.exe at file offset 7211524, value absent from every local file and from _RefGame_World_Config); this is the one number still unrecoverable without a binary trace. [AUTHORED] hpMult/xpMult/spExpMult/lootRolls ride ONE flat 2x champion / 8x giant ladder; the shipping client's arena tier weights (Media/textdata/textuisystem.txt line 4092 — Normal 1 / Champion 3 / Giant 8 / Elite 60) corroborate the ORDERING and the giant 8x, while champion is held at 2x to keep the ladder consistent across axes. [AUTHORED, deliberate] dmgMult 1 on BOTH tiers — variants are HP/reward sponges, never harder hitters; monsterDefenseStats likewise gives every rarity identical defense and ratings (invariant asserted in monsterVariants.test.ts). dmgMult stays wired through spawn -> MonsterEntity.atkMult so the lever survives, it is simply inert at 1. NOT scaled by rarity anywhere: level, physDef/magDef, ratings (par/mar/er/br/hr/chr), attackIntervalMs, walk/run speed, aggro/leash range, respawn cadence, per-drop chance, and the skill list itself (retail-correct — Tab_RefTactics carries no skill columns, and all 238 dwChampionTacticsID links resolve to the same dwObjID).
monsterVariants.$lootRollsMeaning: lootRolls = number of full passes over the drop table (per the shipped $comment).
monsterVariants.$perNestOverride: nest-format zones override champion chance per nest via slot.nest.championPct (nest schema field championPct: z.number().min(0).max(100)); the global champion.chance is the LEGACY-zone fallback only.

monsterRewards.$schema: z.object({ $comment: z.string().optional(), xpSpFactorByDelta: z.record(z.string(), z.number().min(0).max(1)), xpSpFactorBeyond: z.number().min(0).max(1), noDropDeltaMin: z.number().int().positive(), lowerMonsterDropBonusByDelta: z.record(z.string(), z.number().min(0)), questCreditUnaffected: z.boolean() })
monsterRewards.$comment: PROVISIONAL player-vs-monster level-gap policy (fidelity audit §3, oracle §9.3-9.6 open). delta = recipientLevel - monsterLevel. The >=9 no-drop boundary is the product rule; the XP/SP decay curve follows the SRO Origin Mobile publication as a stand-in for the (uncaptured) desktop curve. lowerMonsterDropBonusByDelta values are named 1.0 placeholders — do NOT invent bonus percentages and call them Silkroad. Applied per RECIPIENT for XP/SP and per LOOT OWNER for gold/items; quest kill credit is unaffected.
monsterRewards.$application: per RECIPIENT for XP/SP, per LOOT OWNER for gold/items; delta >= noDropDeltaMin (9) means no drops at all; quest kill credit unaffected.
monsterRewards.$clientUiUse: client target frame: delta >= noDropDeltaMin -> label ui.target.gap_no_drops (#c9484f); delta > 0 with xpSpFactorByDelta[delta] < 1 -> ui.target.gap_reduced (#c9a54f)
